dialogues.speaker: Arataki "Burning Passion for Battle" Itto
dialogues.text: "Kujou Tengu! Didn't we agree to have a sumo duel? Where've you run off to!?"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "Burning Passion for Battle" Itto
dialogues.text: "Bet you lost a fight and can't show your face outside anymore, eh? Hope you're not crying in some corner with your bald wings wrapped around yourself or anything!"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "Burning Passion for Battle" Itto
dialogues.text: "Come on, don't worry about it! You win some and you lose some, am I right?"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "Burning Passion for Battle" Itto
dialogues.text: "Seriously though, I've got no time for your moping. We've got a duel to settle!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Madam Kujou has never been defeated in battle and remains triumphant today. Please do not slander her, you knave!
